# hyperlite_storage_pool (Data Source)

A storage pool, to put disks and volumes in it, or to check its free space.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperlite_storage_pool" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

output "free_gb" {
  value = data.hyperlite_storage_pool.default.available_gb
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The pool's name.

### Optional

- `node` (String) The cluster member that holds the pool, as on its resource (`local` when absent: the node the provider talks to).

### Read-Only

- `allocation_gb` (Number) What its volumes use, in GB.
- `autostart` (Boolean) Started with its node.
- `available_gb` (Number) What is left, in GB.
- `capacity_gb` (Number) Its size, in GB.
- `id` (String) The pool's name.
- `path` (String) Where its volumes are.
- `state` (String) `active`, `inactive`, `building`, `degraded` or `inaccessible`.
- `type` (String) `dir`, `netfs`, `iscsi`, `zfs`...
- `uuid` (String) Its libvirt UUID.
